summary: Senti Biosciences Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance and sale of $10.0 million in aggregate principal of Senior Secured Convertible Notes to Celadon Partners SPV 24 by its wholly owned subsidiary, Senti Holdings. The notes are issued under a previously disclosed Securities Purchase Agreement dated April 27, 2026. Specific terms such as conversion price, maturity, and interest rate are not detailed here but incorporated by reference. Acquiom Agency Services LLC serves as collateral agent. This is a routine debt financing transaction with no change of control or special-situation event.
